text: Construction progress is measured by quantities: the installed quantity of each CWP (quantities field of the CWP: concrete, piles, steel, equipment, pipe, cable, instruments) is recorded per IWP each week and credited against the planned quantity; where quantities are not defined the work is measured by the milestone steps above. The progress of a work area is the average of its CWP weighted by budget hours; the CWP release follows the EWP and PWP conditions of ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PLN-0002.
